content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Data Entry Operator (DEO) and 1 for Project Nurse III.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator (DEO): 12th pass from a recognized board with 3 years of experience in data management work. Project Nurse III: Diploma in Nursing or Midwifery (GNM) or equivalent AND Registered nurse or ANM with any State Nursing Council OR BSc. Nursing.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator (DEO): As per ICMR guidelines Project Nurse III: As per ICMR guidelines

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Data Entry Operator and Project Nurse-III posts is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Data Entry Operator and Project Nurse-III positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: For the Data Entry Operator position, candidates must have passed the 12th grade from a recognized board and possess 3 years of experience in data management work.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications for the Project Nurse-III post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Nurse-III role, candidates need a Diploma in Nursing or Midwifery (GNM) or equivalent, and be a registered nurse or ANM with any State Nursing Council, or hold a BSc. Nursing degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for both the Data Entry Operator and Project Nurse-III positions will be as per the guidelines set by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of CV and experience, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for candidates applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send my application for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to [email protected] with the subject line "Post for the Data Entry Operator (DEO) and Project Nurse-III". You also need to submit your CV at Room No. 835, Department of Pediatrics, Mother and Child Block, AIIMS, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi is N-2741.
